title: Chat Hider
description: This is a Minecraft Mod that allows you to Hide and Show the chat at will by typing /chathider in the chat to toggle it.
body:
# Chat Hider

Hide or show your Minecraft chat whenever you want with a simple command.

## Features

-  Toggle chat visibility on and off instantly.
-  Uses the `/chathider` command to switch between hidden and visible chat.
-  Lightweight and simple—no unnecessary configuration.

## Usage

Type the following command in chat:

```text
/chathider
```

Running the command will toggle the chat between **hidden** and **visible**.

## Why use Chat Hider?

Chat Hider is useful if you want to:

- Take clean screenshots without chat.
- Reduce distractions while playing.
- Quickly hide chat during gameplay or streaming.
- Toggle chat without changing Minecraft settings.

## Compatibility

- Client-side mod.
- Does not require installation on servers.
- Safe to use on multiplayer servers unless the server specifically restricts client-side mods.
